title: Dead End City — impacts and motorcycles
introduction: Native game screenshots of the downloaded Dolcati V4, airborne vehicle strikes, KUZUKI 600R wheelie and Graphics settings. The model comparisons use matched inspection cameras, High graphics, clear weather and 13:00. Before uses the previous published branch build (7f45832a). Click an image for its original size; capture inputs and limits are in the linked audit.

comparisons.title: Dolcati V4 — side view
comparisons.description: The procedural bike is replaced by ROY’s downloaded Panigale V4 source, with detailed brakes, wheels, fairing, cockpit and fitted rider contacts.

comparisons.title: Dolcati V4 — front view
comparisons.description: The close source mesh preserves authored geometry and shading; a shared reduced mesh serves distant traffic.

screenshots.title: Player — airborne vehicle strike
screenshots.description: A held physics fixture after a 65 km/h sedan strike. The body carries forward momentum and rises under gravity; this is an actual game pose.

screenshots.title: Player — continuing tumble
screenshots.description: The same strike advanced through further flight. Pose and height are driven by the shared ballistic state.

screenshots.title: Pedestrian — airborne vehicle strike
screenshots.description: An NPC follows the same flight system as the player, with edge-dependent sideways rotation.

screenshots.title: Pedestrian — continuing tumble
screenshots.description: NPC impact motion continues through flight and landing, including when a strike is fatal. The capture receipt records this fixture’s health and phase.

screenshots.title: KUZUKI 600R — wheelie
screenshots.description: Throttle plus Up lifts the front. Down applies the rear brake and lowers it, including while throttle is held. Rear tyre contact and rider placement follow the bike.

screenshots.title: Graphics settings
screenshots.description: Motion blur is removed and disabled. Player outline and ring default to off; explicit saved choices for those two aids are preserved.

sounds.title: KUZUKI 600R — idle, six gears, limiter and overrun

soundDescription: An isolated offline render of the shipped engine graph with the actual CC0 ZX6R and Suzuki inline-four loops: idle, a six-gear pull, limiter, closed-throttle braking and mute. It excludes global mix processing, ambience, radio and cabin acoustics. This is a sound demonstration, not a gameplay recording or an exact GSX-R600 recording.
